messages.text: Per Joanna, she said that dancer's no longer have to pay their house fees upfront anymore.
Entertainers can now submit content for our social media.. they must refresh the app to see the new button
there are also a bunch of rubber bands at T2 that i placed in one of the baskets on the shelf underneath the printer
Fuck yeah, I just found them.
and also new batteries in the scale at T1

just want to make sure everyone is clear... and to make sure the girls know (thru you) all these changes that I have been enforcing (and having you enforce) did NOT come from me... I have just been doing the thing you are supposed to do and that is, carry out your employers wishes... I am glad that we are no longer having to enforce the pay house fees upfront or go home policy.. enough said about that.
i think he is talking to you Steven

I've let all dancers know that no one is at fault for having to pay the house fees upfront, and that it was all just miscommunication and that it's no one's fault and that we understand that all dancers are here to make money and that we appreciate them for working at The Torch and if they have any concerns that they can text Bob or Animal.
